content: nats-io/nats.go latest v1.52.0 (May 2026). JetStream dedup via Nats-Msg-Id header on publish; server rejects duplicates within a per-stream dedup window (default 2 min, configurable via --dupe-window). This is exactly-once PUBLISH within the window, not end-to-end exactly-once; consumers still need idempotent processing (at-least-once delivery + double-ack).
